notes.title: Halloween Special Stream
notes.notes:
🌙 Event Overview:
Prepare for a spine-chilling, heart-racing event as the legendary streamer, IndieVR, delves into the darkest corners of the Halloween edition of "Rotten Apple", the most exhilarating VR Zombie bonanza to hit the market!

🧟‍♂️ Game Highlight: Rotten Apple (Halloween Edition)
Descend into a post-apocalyptic New York, now overrun by nefarious undead creatures. But this isn’t your regular apocalypse – it's Halloween in the Big Apple! Navigate haunted streets, explore eerie subways, and discover creepy secrets as you hunt or be hunted. Experience terror like never before, with special Halloween-themed content and easter eggs.

🎮 Why Watch IndieVR?
Renowned for his unmatched VR skills and infectious enthusiasm, IndieVR promises an electrifying playthrough. With crisp commentary, immersive reactions, and a few shrieks here and there, it's guaranteed to be a night of unforgettable thrills!

notes.title: Museum Release - Live Stream
notes.notes:
Welcome to Rotten Apple VR! Live Streaming this crazy new zombie game with IndieVR & Mac In VR! This game supports up to 4 player co op drop in/out servers. They will be playing the new Museum map for the first time.

There are plenty of zombie types and bosses, you unlock them by reaching a certain round, then the next difficulty unlocks. There are 4 unlockable difficulty types and it gets HARD. Each one introduces a new weather system and a new Zombie type.

You need to get to wave 15 at danger 1 to unlock danger 2, get to wave 20 at danger 2 to unlock danger 3 & get to wave 25 at danger 3 to get to danger 4, the hardest difficulty.

Call Of Duty Zombies in VR meets After The Fall = TOTAL CARNAGE! Imagine waves and waves of VR Zombies relentlessly charging at you... How long will you survive?

Join forces with up to 3 friends in Rotten Apple, a thrilling VR co-op zombie shooter! Face the apocalypse, tackle high-stakes challenges, and battle relentless undead hordes. Are you ready to conquer post-apocalyptic NYC together?

Embark on the ultimate undead showdown in Rotten Apple, a heart-pounding VR zombie shooter experience that brings you and your friends face-to-face with the apocalypse. This breathtakingly immersive co-op adventure, meticulously crafted for virtual reality, invites you and up to three friends to plunge deep into the treacherous Quarantine Zone and rewrite the fate of a missing research team.

Discover Rotten Apple's innovative VR gameplay mechanics and state-of-the-art graphics that transport you into a post-apocalyptic New York City like never before.

IndieVR: https://www.youtube.com/@IndieVR
MacInVR: https://www.youtube.com/@MacInVR

notes.title: Story release!
notes.notes:
You are transported to the border of the Quarantine Zone to assist the struggling guards in their shift when suddenly a distress signal from the researcher team comes in. They are under attack by an unknown enemy! The sergeant sends you on a mission to find the researchers, ensure their survival, and safeguard the all-important research data. Can you fight off the relentless undead, solve puzzles on your perilous journey, and rescue them in a race against time?

Battle "the Unknown" and confront the enemy who is responsible for the reason why New York has fallen.

Join us on this unforgettable journey and prepare yourself for a VR Zombie experience like no other. Follow the adventure, participate in discussions, ask questions, and perhaps, even pick up some pro-gaming tips from IndieVR and MacInVR. Are you ready to face the apocalypse?

notes.title: Rotten Apple Multiplayer Beta Mayhem - A PCVR Zombie Shooter Showdown
notes.notes:
Rotten Apple VR: The Ultimate Zombie Shooter Multiplayer Beta Blasts Onto Steam

Grab your VR headset and prepare for an adrenaline-pumping adventure! We are thrilled to announce the launch of the highly-anticipated multiplayer Beta for Rotten Apple, the groundbreaking VR Zombie Shooter, exclusively on Steam.

Set in a post-apocalyptic New York City overrun by the undead, Rotten Apple invites players to join forces with fellow survivors in an immersive, heart-pounding virtual reality experience. With its cutting-edge graphics, realistic sound effects, and dynamic gameplay, Rotten Apple pushes the boundaries of VR technology to deliver the most exhilarating zombie shooter yet.

Key features of Rotten Apple include:

[list]
[*] Intense Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with friends or other players from around the globe to take on relentless hordes of zombies in an immersive story or the brand-new endless mode. 

[*] Diverse Arsenal & Customization: Choose from an extensive range of weapons and upgrade them to suit your playstyle. 

[*] Massive Enemy Encounters: Face off against hordes of diverse adversaries, providing a thrilling challenge and non-stop action as you navigate through intense, large-scale battles in a dynamic PCVR gaming experience.
[/list]

Beta access for Rotten Apple is now available on Steam, and we invite gamers from around the world to join the frontlines of this epic battle against the undead. Your feedback is crucial in helping us fine-tune the gameplay, iron out any kinks, and create the ultimate VR zombie shooter experience. Together, let's put the rotten back in the Big Apple!

For more information and updates, follow Rotten Apple on social media and visit our official website at https://rottenapple-vr.com/.
